facts.fact: Vanguard reports the Humanitarian Affairs minister saying that 'every NIN issued' from the mobile vehicles moves a person into the system, with the units equipped for biometric registration.
The minister and UNHCR say displaced people cannot open a bank account or register a SIM card without a NIN, so banks and SIM registration rely on the national ID.
facts.system: Bank and SIM registration NIN requirement

facts.fact: The Federal Government, UNHCR and Germany handed 10 mobile one-stop-shop vehicles to 10 states to take NIN, birth registration, SIM registration and bank account opening to displaced people, against an estimated 3.7 million internally displaced.
